name: Sentora PRIME Main
oneLiner: senPYUSDPRIMEv2 is Sentora's PYUSD Morpho Vault V2 share; yield and losses change NAV, and cash redemption depends on idle PYUSD.
collateral: PYUSD loans against the Hastra PRIME token (0x19ebb35279a16207ec4ba82799cc64715065f7f6; on-chain name Hastra PRIME), described by Sentora as Figure home-equity credit exposure. Enforceable collateral recovery priority remains unresolved.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 deposit/mint and withdraw/redeem exchange shares for PYUSD at the current asset conversion rate. Lending interest, fees and realized losses change NAV. At Ethereum block 26197388 (2026-10-15), liquidityAdapter() is zero, so ordinary cash redemptions use idle PYUSD unless assets are first deallocated. Holder-initiated forceDeallocate through the current adapter calls Morpho.withdraw and charges a 1% penalty on assets deallocated; it still requires market cash liquidity. This exact adapter does not transfer lender positions to the holder. VaultV2 maxWithdraw and maxRedeem deliberately return zero as conservative underestimates, not measurements of available exit liquidity.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Exact Ethereum deployment 0xc21b08c16458202593d4d9b26b9984ee67b38bbd is immutable VaultV2, issuing transferable ERC-4626 operational shares over PYUSD, not a direct fiat or parent-reserve ownership claim. At block 26197388 (2026-10-15T10:42:47Z), asset() is PYUSD, decimals()=18, totalSupply()=105776048725271220285649074 and convertToAssets(10^18)=2027558 PYUSD base units. Vault and sole adapter runtime match their exact verified sources and all three EIP-1967 proxy slots are zero. The original one-share redeem simulation remains evidence at block 26107702 only; no new execution measurement is claimed. The protocol-position archetype intentionally differs from the fiat-cash parent. Morpho exact-vault creation metadata and the factory creation transaction confirm block 25052763, timestamp 1778272391 (2026-05-08T20:33:11Z).
